alerte.texte: Your choices are ready: the still map panel (video on the map page) and points 1, 2, 6 and 7 of Hick's law (15 options). All seven accepted Hick's law changes are reviewed and wait for their pictures.

depuis.texte: CI only: the nightly route sweep may now write its tracking tickets.
Messages: a thread opened from a notification now goes back to your inbox with Back, like X and Instagram.
Messages: tapping the Messages tab from inside a thread always lands on your inbox, clearing the threads opened on top.
Website: documents always show in the chosen language, and the welcome page is no longer fetched ahead of time.
A lint rule now blocks the two ways of opening a page that skipped the double-tap guard. Found by the Hick's law audit.
Every pull request that changes the app must now show it breaks nothing (its regression study), or a check fails. Your request of 10/10.
Profile song chip and picker on mobile and web

On the map search, picking a suggestion writes its name in the bar, ready to be written over; the places follow the typing sooner and the flight takes 1.2 s instead of 2.4. Your TestFlight point; for the next build.

Messages and the Profile are prepared ahead while you rest on Amis, switched off by default. Measured on a cloud iPhone: off, it costs nothing; on, it slows nothing and makes launch lighter (12 network reads instead of 22). For the next build.
An official Take's video is removed only when the video site says it is gone twice, a day apart; one passing error no longer removes it for good. It reaches staging with the next server deploy.

claude.libelle: A Claude is fixing it here

enCours.sujet: Hick's law: the seven changes you accepted
enCours.ouEnEst: One pull request per point you accepted (3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10 and 12). Each had two reviews; the five defects they found are fixed. Cloud iPhones are taking the before and after pictures: the sign-in sheet without its cross already matches the mock-up.
enCours.reste: Pictures, then merge them one by one.

enCours.sujet: Hick's law: your choice for points 1, 2, 6 and 7
enCours.ouEnEst: The Hick's law page now shows only the four points you want redone, with 15 options from the audit and two agents (one starting from X, one from Instagram, Threads and Apple).
enCours.reste: Your choice, then a Claude builds it.

enCours.sujet: Map search suggestions follow every letter
enCours.ouEnEst: Suggestions come about three times sooner and follow every letter. The still panel you asked for is filmed side by side and already coded.
enCours.reste: Your choice on the video, then merge.

enCours.sujet: Private profile shows friends, Takes and score
enCours.ouEnEst: You approved the pictures. Brought up to date with main; a last check of the test that failed only because the branch was behind is running.

No more fade on the suggestion panel, and the list follows every letter. A review found two problems: the CI is still red, and one lookup per letter would use up the people-search quota, so suggestions and profiles could be refused. Fixed in the app, without touching the rate limiter.
enCours.reste: Fix, review, measure with your network delay, then your OK.

enCours.sujet: Explore pages going blank during quick changes
enCours.ouEnEst: The missing test is written and reviewed: it fails when the fix's lines are removed. CI is green.
enCours.reste: Pictures and a measurement on a device, then your OK.

enCours.ouEnEst: Cause found: in bounded mode, rows already drawn lose and get back their pictures and videos about 165 times per scroll, against 0 when it is off. A two-line fix is ready; the clean measurement runs on the Mac until about 4:05.
enCours.reste: If the extra jank goes away, the fix goes into the pull request.

enCours.sujet: Development seed carries the test loop's data
enCours.ouEnEst: The seed now writes everything the regression loop needs, so no more manual catch-up after each seed, and it clears its accounts' old quizzes and precomputed pages. Two reviews, CI green.

enCours.sujet: CI checks: route names and pictures
enCours.ouEnEst: Found tonight: the CI never checked page names in the app, so a wrong one could pass; the fix is in review. The picture check of pull requests passed on bot logos; now only real pictures count (#4832, ready). Two flaky tests are fixed too, one of which hid real bursts of video-check calls to oEmbed (#4836).

enCours.sujet: Taps lost when two arrive within one frame
enCours.ouEnEst: Two fingers overlapping on the same button count once, which is React Native's normal touch model; taps apart, even barely, both count.

equipe: Here on the Mac: me, five Claude agents (fixes, reviews, tests), the audit agent measuring the videos, and your emulator on staging.
On Replicas, on Muse Spark through OpenCode: wombat and fouine (pictures on cloud iPhones), harfang (mentions) and vison (private profile). Claude is still out on Replicas.
etapes: Your choices: the map panel, and Hick's law points 1, 2, 6 and 7.
Hick's law: pictures, then merge the seven pull requests.
After the video measurement: merge the ready ones (seed, picture check, private profile).
Mentions: fix the two review problems, then measure with your network delay.
